extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from packet notes, primary XML, figure captions, and local supplementary text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptide 6 activity is LPS-dependent in the local LPS competition assay because MIC shifts upward when 1 mg/mL LPS is present; this direct mechanism evidence is limited to peptide 6.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Not generalized to every analogue without separate assay support.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The NPN assay supports outer-membrane permeabilization by the tested potent synergists against E. coli BW25113, but the local packet provides figure-level rather than table-level exact NPN uptake values.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: potent synergists characterized in Figure 7/Figure S16
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote exact NPN percentages beyond local figure/caption support.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Alanine-scan source tables support a structure-activity context in which lysine substitutions lose synergy and increase hemolysis, consistent with nonselective membrane disruption for those variants.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Pattern-based mechanism context, not a direct molecular target assay for each variant.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Mechanism evidence is bounded to qualitative/direct-assay support and does not invent exact figure values.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local text/captions support the NPN assay and qualitative/figure-level interpretation, but no machine-readable numeric NPN uptake table is present in the packet.
